items.title: Approval of the Minutes of July 28, 2026
Update on General Manager selection process
Approve the Water Supply Assessment for the proposed Treasure Island Residential Program Modification Project
Adopt a refined Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act CEQA and award Contract No. WD-2915

Award Contract No. WW-770, Oceanside Water Pollution Control Plant HVAC Upgrades, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Monterey Mechanical Co., in the amount of $22,309,000

Approve Amendment No. 2 to Contract No. CS-249, Planning and Design Services, Mountain Tunnel Improvements, with Jacobs Associates, Inc., dba Delve Underground, formerly known as McMillen Jacobs Associates, Inc.
Public Comment on matters to be addressed during Closed Session
Motion on whether to assert the attorney-client privilege regarding the matters listed below CLOSED SESSION
Motion regarding whether to disclose the discussion during Closed Session pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code Section 67.12(a).
